novelty_point.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法Sketch-DBH，利用Count-Min Sketch存储节点度数信息，并使用最小堆维护高频节点信息，实现常数时间内返回查询结果并生成子图编号，确保负载均衡。
novelty_point.claim_en: Propose an edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm Sketch-DBH, which uses Count-Min Sketch to store node degree information and a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information, enabling constant-time query results and generating subgraph IDs to ensure load balancing.
technical_features: 使用Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
在常数时间内返回查询结果
根据节点度数信息生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号
高效完成大规模图流数据的划分且确保负载均衡
technical_features_en: Use Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure to store degree information of each node
Use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information in graph stream data
Return query results in constant time
Generate the subgraph ID to which a single graph stream data item will be assigned based on node degree information
Efficiently partition large-scale graph stream data and ensure load balancing
source_locations: 作者贡献段2：提出了一种新的基于边分割的图流划分算法——Sketch-DBH，用于处理大规模图流数据下的子图划分问题。该算法通过Count-Min Sketch 这一概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息，并使用一个最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息，使其可以在常数时间内返回查询结果并以此根据节点度数信息生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号。Sketch-DBH 算法可以高效完成大规模图流数据的划分且确保负载均衡

cards.document_title: 2PS: High-Quality Edge Partitioning with Two-Phase Streaming
cards.main_contribution: Proposes 2PS, a two-phase streaming edge partitioning algorithm that separates vertices into clusters in the first phase and performs edge partitioning in the second phase, achieving low replication factor with low memory overhead.
overlaps: Streaming assignment of edges to partitions
Load balancing and replication minimization objectives
differences: Uses a two-phase streaming clustering approach rather than edge-segmentation with Count-Min Sketch
Does not use Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure for degree storage
Does not use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information
No constant-time query mechanism for subgraph ID generation is described

sources.title: 2PS: High-Quality Edge Partitioning with Two-Phase Streaming
sources.quote: In this paper, we propose 2PS, a novel two-phase streaming algorithm for high-quality edge partitioning. In the first phase, vertices are separated into clusters by a lightweight streaming clustering algorithm. In the second phase, the graph is re-streamed and edge partitioning is performed while taking into account the clustering of the vertices from the first phase.

cards.main_contribution: Proposes WStream, a window-based streaming graph partitioning algorithm (edge-cut partitioning) that partitions large graph data while keeping load balanced across partitions and minimizing communication.
overlaps: Graph stream partitioning method domain (streaming one-pass graph partitioning)
Load balancing across partitions as a core objective
Assigning graph data items to partitions/subgraphs
differences: Uses a window-based edge-cut partitioning strategy rather than edge-segmentation with Count-Min Sketch
Does not use Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure for degree storage
Does not use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information
No constant-time query mechanism for subgraph ID generation is described

sources.title: Window-based Streaming Graph Partitioning Algorithm
sources.quote: This paper proposes an efficient window-based streaming graph partitioning algorithm called WStream. The WStream algorithm is an edge-cut partitioning algorithm, which distributes a vertex among the partitions. Our results suggest that the WStream algorithm is able to partition large graph data efficiently while keeping the load balanced across different partitions, and communication to a minimum.

evidence.quote: This paper proposes an efficient window-based streaming graph partitioning algorithm called WStream. The WStream algorithm is an edge-cut partitioning algorithm, which distributes a vertex among the partitions. Our results suggest that the WStream algorithm is able to partition large graph data efficiently while keeping the load balanced across different partitions, and communication to a minimum.
evidence.interpretation: WStream is a streaming graph partitioning algorithm that achieves load balancing across partitions, overlapping with the general method domain of NP-3 (graph stream partitioning with load balancing), but it uses a window-based edge-cut mechanism rather than Count-Min Sketch and min-heap.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose 2PS, a novel two-phase streaming algorithm for high-quality edge partitioning. In the first phase, vertices are separated into clusters by a lightweight streaming clustering algorithm. In the second phase, the graph is re-streamed and edge partitioning is performed while taking into account the clustering of the vertices from the first phase.
evidence.interpretation: 2PS performs streaming edge partitioning using a two-phase clustering mechanism, overlapping with the general graph stream partitioning domain of NP-3, but it does not use Count-Min Sketch or a min-heap for degree-based constant-time subgraph assignment.
